name: ifetch
purpose: One instruction-fetch model for both architectures (mechanism-merge-plan.md section 2.1): L0/L1 instruction cache capacities, per-line streaming cost at each level (L1 warm, L2 warm, cold = code from DRAM after ncu --cache-control all), launch prefetch window and fetch sharing. The h100 tree carries predecessor fields measured under cache-control none (miss 307 / stream 60 / 64 KiB free fill); these are replaced, not reconciled. b300 is re-measured with the same probe build to confirm the installed leaf (ifetch-r2) within 10 %.
probe: blackwell-prototype tools/microbench/probes/ifetch.cu + ifetch_bodies.hpp / ifetch_jump.hpp (gen_ifetch_bodies.py, gen_ifetch_jump.py) + mb.cuh, copied verbatim into tools/microbench/ifetch/probe/ and compiled with -arch=sm_90a / sm_103a. Variants ifetch.line.n<N>.w<W> (N in 256..32768 IADD3 = 4 KiB..512 KiB straight-line code, W in 1,4,16 warps running the same code), ifetch.jump.m<M>.p<PERM>.w1 (M in 16..4096 128 B blocks, PERM 0 sequential / 1 stride permutation), ifetch.mix.n<N>.w<W> (W warps each on distinct code). K = 4 passes per launch, per-warp clock64 pair around the body; pass 0 under --cache-control all is the cold regime, passes 1..3 warm. SASS gate (sass_check.py check_ifetch): exactly N IADD3 inside the clock window, no memory instructions, blocks 128 B apart, zero spills; a variant failing the gate is void.
runner: ncu --csv --page raw --metrics sm__cycles_active.max,smsp__warps_issue_stalled_no_instruction.sum,smsp__warps_active.sum,smsp__inst_executed.sum --replay-mode kernel --cache-control all --clock-control none, 16 launches per variant (first 2 dropped); a second run with --cache-control none is recorded for reference only (not installed). One GPU per device is sufficient (the predecessor's two-GPU B300 agreement was within 1 %).

derivation.capacity_l0_bytes: largest footprint 16*N whose warm (pass>=1) cpi stays on the level-0 plateau (cpi within 2 % of the smallest-N warm cpi)
derivation.capacity_l1_bytes: largest footprint whose warm cpi stays on the L1 plateau (the second plateau); beyond it warm passes stream from L2
derivation.stream_l1_cycles_per_line: warm cpi on the L1 plateau minus the level-0 cpi, times 8 instructions per 128 B line, times fetch_parallelism (predecessor form: 8 x marginal slope agreeing with the cpi-difference form within 10 %)
derivation.stream_l2_cycles_per_line: same for footprints between capacity_l1 and the L2 code set (warm passes beyond capacity_l1)
derivation.stream_cold_cycles_per_line: pass-0 (cache-control all) cpi minus level-0 cpi, times 8, for footprints beyond launch_prefetch_bytes (where the cold pass is not hidden by the launch prefetch)
derivation.launch_prefetch_bytes: largest footprint whose pass-0 cycles under cache-control all are explained by stream_l1 alone (prefetch arrives at L1 pace); above it the cold stream appears
derivation.fetch_parallelism: number of concurrent line fills = ceil(stream_cold / jump.p1 per-block latency difference ...); taken from k_jump: (per-block cycles PERM=1 minus PERM=0) / stream_cold gives the fills in flight hidden by sequential prefetch; rounded to the nearest power of two
derivation.sharing: 0 if k_line cpi is flat in W (one fetch serves the SM), 1 if cpi grows with W (per-SMSP/warp fetch)
derivation.line_bytes: 128 (SASS gate: block start addresses 128 B apart)

acceptance: Plateaus must be visible (>= 3 footprints on each); warm cpi must not depend on W for W <= 4 (else sharing = 1 and the per-warp form is installed); b300 re-measurement must agree with the installed b300 leaf within 10 % per field, otherwise both numbers are reported and the new one is installed as experimental. h100 fields are installed as measured only when the two derivation forms for stream_* agree within 10 %; otherwise experimental.
install: <arch>/leaves/instruction.fetch.json with one source key per device `ifetch.<device>.<run>` (evidence measured/experimental per acceptance), artifact = $A/microbench/ifetch/<run>/ (counters.csv, launches.log, model.json).
